_about: Factions: goals they work toward a step at a time (each, at its last step, becomes a storyteller pitch), what winning gives them, and the light economy: the goods a place makes (from its terrain and size) and needs, and what shortages and gluts do to prices and contracts. prices: trade goods the party can buy and sell, [unit, gp each]; trade: percent changes to them where a place makes, needs, is short of or has plenty of a good, and the gap between buying and selling. grudges: what a faction the party has angered (standing at or below threshold) does about it, as for people. sim.contestPerMonth: how often a faction tries to claim or take a control point within pointMiles of its seat (outposts, watchtowers, quarries, magical industries, a market or tavern it could run); each point it holds adds pointWealth to its wealth a month.

goals.name: Spread its influence
steps: Agents of {faction} have arrived in {place}.
{faction} is buying friends in {place}: loans, gifts and favours.
{faction} is ready to take a real hold on {place}.

climax.title: {faction} takes hold in {place}
climax.text: {faction} is moving to take a hold on {place}: its people are on the council, in the market and at the gates.
climax.dm: {lead} runs it for {faction}, and not everyone they paid stays paid.

goals.name: Win converts
steps: Preachers of {faction} are on the streets of {place}.
{faction} has opened a soup kitchen and a school in {place}.
{faction} has called a great gathering in {place}.

climax.title: A great sermon in {place}
climax.text: {faction} holds a great gathering in {place}, and the whole town is talking about it.
climax.dm: {rival} means to disrupt it, and has hired thugs to do it.
climax.goal: Keep the peace at the gathering.

goals.name: Open a shrine
steps: {faction} has bought land in {place}.
Builders are at work on a shrine of {faction} in {place}.
The shrine is nearly finished, and needs a blessing, or a sacrifice.

climax.title: A shrine for {faction}
climax.text: {faction}'s new shrine in {place} is to be consecrated, and it needs something brought from far away first.
climax.dm: The thing they need is guarded, and the guardians were promised it would never be taken.

goals.name: Take the council
goals.wants: take control of the council of {place}
steps: {faction} has backed a candidate for the council of {place}.
{faction}'s candidate is winning votes with gifts and threats.
The council of {place} votes soon, and {faction} has it nearly won.

climax.title: The vote in {place}
climax.text: The council of {place} votes this week, and {faction} has nearly bought it.
climax.dm: Votes have been bought, and one councillor is being blackmailed by {lead}.

goals.name: Control the trade
steps: {faction} is buying {goods} in {place} at any price.
{faction}'s rivals in the {goods} trade are being squeezed out.
{faction} needs one last deal to own the {goods} trade in {place}.

climax.title: {faction} corners the {goods}
climax.text: {faction} is about to close a deal that gives it the whole {goods} trade through {place}.
climax.dm: The other side of the deal is being forced, and wants a way out.
climax.goal: Help the deal, or break it.

goals.name: Crush a rival
steps: {faction} is gathering what it knows about {rival}.
{faction} is turning {rival}'s friends in {place}.
{faction} is ready to strike at {rival}.

climax.title: {faction} strikes at {rival}
climax.text: {faction} moves against {rival} in {place}, and the streets will not stay quiet.
climax.dm: {faction}'s plan uses the party's name. They will be blamed whether they help or not.
climax.goal: Pick a side, or keep {place} from burning.

goals.name: Seal an alliance
steps: {faction} has sent envoys to {rival}.
{faction} and {rival} are haggling over terms.
The treaty between {faction} and {rival} is to be signed in {place}.

climax.title: A treaty in {place}
climax.text: {faction} and {rival} sign a treaty in {place}, and they want trusted guards for the ceremony.
climax.dm: Someone on each side wants the treaty to fail.

goals.name: Outlaw a rival
steps: {faction} is preaching against {rival} in {place}.
{faction} has brought charges against {rival}'s people.
{faction} is pressing the lords of {place} to outlaw {rival}.

climax.title: {rival} outlawed?
climax.text: The lords of {place} are about to outlaw {rival}, at {faction}'s urging.
climax.dm: Half of {faction}'s charges are true. The other half were made up.
climax.goal: Find the truth before the decree.

goals.name: Recover a relic
goals.wants: recover a relic it lost long ago
steps: {faction} has learned where its lost relic might be.
{faction} has sent searchers, and one did not come back.
{faction} has found the relic's resting place.

climax.title: The lost relic
climax.text: {faction} knows where its lost relic lies, near {place}, and needs someone to fetch it.
climax.dm: The relic is not what {faction} thinks: it is what drove them to lose it.

goals.name: Pay its debts
steps: {faction} is selling land around {place} to pay its debts.
{faction} is calling in every favour it is owed.
{faction} has one last chance to clear its debts, with a risky venture.

climax.title: A risky venture
climax.text: {faction} has staked what is left of its fortune on one venture out of {place}, and needs it guarded.
climax.dm: The venture is a swindle. {faction} is the mark, not the swindler.
climax.goal: Guard the venture, or expose the swindle.

goals.name: Marry well
steps: {faction} has proposed a match with {rival}.
{faction} and {rival} are haggling over the dowry.
The wedding of {faction}'s heir is set, in {place}.

climax.title: The great wedding
climax.text: {faction}'s heir is to marry into {rival} in {place}, and the whole city is invited.
climax.dm: The heir loves someone else, and plans to run on the wedding day.
climax.goal: Keep the wedding on track, or help the heir run.

goals.name: Fund an expedition
goals.wants: fund an expedition into the wilds
steps: {faction} is hiring for an expedition out of {place}.
{faction}'s expedition has set out.
{faction}'s expedition has found something, and gone quiet.

climax.title: The lost expedition
climax.text: {faction}'s expedition out of {place} has stopped sending word, and {faction} wants it found.
climax.dm: The expedition found an astral space, and part of it went in.

goals.name: Raise fighters
steps: {faction} is recruiting in {place}.
{faction}'s new fighters are training openly.
{faction} has enough fighters to make the lords of {place} nervous.

climax.title: {faction}'s fighters
climax.text: {faction}'s new fighters are swaggering through {place}, and the watch wants to know who they answer to.
climax.dm: They answer to {lead}, who has plans {faction} doesn't know about.
climax.goal: Find out what the fighters are for.

goals.name: Plant spies
steps: {faction} is looking for someone inside {rival}.
{faction} has turned one of {rival}'s clerks.
{faction}'s spy is about to steal {rival}'s secrets.

climax.title: A spy in {rival}
climax.text: {faction}'s spy inside {rival} is about to be caught in {place}, and needs getting out.
climax.dm: The spy has been turned back. {faction} is being fed lies.
climax.goal: Get the spy out, or turn the tables.

goals.name: Win the people
goals.wants: win the people of {place} with a festival
steps: {faction} has announced a festival in {place}.
{faction} is spending freely on the festival.
The festival in {place} is about to begin.

climax.title: {faction}'s festival
climax.text: {faction}'s festival in {place} is about to begin, and it is meant to win the town over.
climax.dm: {rival} has a plan to ruin it.
climax.goal: Enjoy the festival, and keep it from going wrong.

goals.name: Summon a power
steps: Cultists of {faction} are gathering in secret around {place}.
{faction} has taken people from {place} for its rite.
The rite of {faction} is set for the next dark moon.

climax.title: The rite of {faction}
climax.text: {faction} will finish its rite near {place} at the dark moon, and the people it took are still alive.
climax.dm: The rite will work if it isn't stopped.
climax.goal: Stop the rite and save the captives.

wanted.healing potions: someone to fetch herbs for the healers
wanted.rope: escorts for the rope makers' carts

acts.news: Word in {place}: the party can't be trusted
acts.name: A smear
acts.text: {faction} is spreading word around {place} that the party cannot be trusted.

acts.name: Blacklisted
acts.text: {faction} has told its people in {place} not to deal with the party.

acts.name: Contracts kept away
acts.text: {faction} is leaning on the Adventure Society in {place} to keep good contracts away from the party.
acts.dm: The next contract board near {place} offers the party one fewer good notice.

acts.name: Watchers
acts.text: {faction} has set people to watch the party.
acts.dm: Someone has been following them for days. A spy may already be close to them.

acts.name: An ambush
acts.text: {faction} has sent armed men to ambush the party on the road near {place}.
acts.dm: A fight at a bad place on the road: a bridge, a gully, a ford.

acts.news: The party named in a robbery in {place}
acts.name: Framed
acts.text: Witnesses paid by {faction} swear the party were behind a robbery in {place}.
acts.dm: The watch has a warrant, and the witnesses can be broken.

acts.name: Killers hired
acts.text: {faction} has hired killers to deal with the party for good.
acts.dm: Killers a rank above the party, who strike when they are split up.
